title: How Maximor built its core engineering team with Contrario
summary: Maximor set an uncompromising bar for its engineering team: top-tier international talent, and nothing below it. The challenge was never finding engineers. It was finding ones who cleared that bar, and finding them fast.
body_markdown:
Maximor is an AI-native finance platform whose Audit-Ready Agents automate the finance and accounting work CFO teams usually do by hand. The company raised $10M in seed funding led by Foundation Capital.


Ajay, Maximor's founder/CTO and an IIT Bombay engineer, set the hiring bar himself. Every engineer had to match the caliber of school and company he trusted, a bar narrow enough that filling it usually means a long, grinding search.
